core_meaning.primary_meaning: Himayat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Protection, guardianship, safeguard”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Himayat corresponds to the Arabic form حماية (Arabic root ح م ي (ḥ-m-y); حِمَايَة (Ḥimāya)). Its core sense is protection, guardianship, safeguard. Himayat is Arabic حِمَايَة (Ḥimāya) 'protection, guardianship, safeguard', from the root ح م ي (ḥ-m-y). The source gloss 'Protection, Guardianship' is consistent. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily a common noun. The source labelled the name unisex; documented usage is predominantly female.

persian.name: حمایت
persian.long_meaning: Himayat (حمایت) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن حمایت، نگهبانی، پاسداری است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: حماية
